muzika

muzika is a small soundcloud player made with two rules in mind: it has to look good, and it has to stay light.

Most desktop players today are a browser in disguise and eat memory like one. muzika only draws while you are looking at it. Minimize it, hide it in the tray or alt-tab into a game, and every animation stops. Only the sound keeps going.

draws nothing in the tray or behind a gameperformance
media keys work from inside any gamecontrol
counts real listening time, not just playsstats
shows the track and progress in your statusdiscord

theme, color and glass
theme

covers in color, and muzika takes on the color of the cover that is playing. the switch in the player does the same.

big letters

dots builds the big letters on the player out of dots, like the update screen. swipe the mouse through them. they rebuild when the track changes.

visualizer

style and when it runs
visualizer style

everything sleeps in the tray and behind a game, whichever style you pick.

visualizer

focus: the visualizer pauses while the window is not active, for example when you are in a game. fullscreen keeps it running.

playback

fades, likes, cache
transitions

the next track fades in while the current one fades out. switching by hand uses a short fade.

hearts

the heart adds the track to your likes in muzika. "+ soundcloud" also tries to like it on soundcloud, which may ask for a captcha there.

soundcloud cache

streamed tracks are kept here so replays start instantly. oldest go first when it's full.

off

switch it on and your discord profile shows the track, its cover with the muzika disc, the time left and a soundcloud button. discord just has to be open on this pc.

muzika

muzika checks once when it starts. if there's a new version it downloads on the loading screen and opens already updated.

backup & data

export, restore, move
backup

one file with your likes, playlists, stats and settings. the soundcloud login stays out, so it's safe to keep anywhere.

move from another folder

pick an older muzika folder: library, stats, likes and the soundcloud login come over, then muzika restarts.
